description: ESA-derived species common name; blank if unavailable. Subspecies-specific common names are not promoted to the whole species.
Service classification where available; otherwise original GBIF classification. Weighted modal pair resolves conflicting classifications; conflicts are logged.
Same classification policy as order.
Resolved species-level canonical name; subspecies rolled up to species.
Number of eligible regional occurrence records, not individuals. The same record contributes separately to its Level III and IV checklists.
Yes when a named record supports occurrence on the property; otherwise blank, not evidence of absence. Includes qualified identifications, with qualifiers in evidence table.
Reviewed life-history summary; blank when not reviewed. See life_history_sources and literature_review_status. Not inferred from coordinates.
Regional records in CDFW Sand Dune Sedge Swaths or Silver Dune Lupine - Mock Heather Scrub polygons. Point matches include uncertain coordinates; uncertainty diagnostics remain in record audit.
Regional records in CDFW Coastal Strand polygons; collection-location association, not species specialization.
Regional records in USGS Qey Holocene beach and dune sand polygons. Combined beach/dune substrate class.
Regional records in USGS Qeo Pleistocene dune substrate. Does not establish current dune habitat.
Regional records with one matching CDFW vegetation polygon. Unmapped means outside polygons, not non-coastal habitat.
Regional records with one matching USGS geology polygon.

Distinct USGS geologic unit names matched by regional occurrence coordinates for the species, sorted and separated by commas. Names only, no unit codes or counts. Blank if no named single-polygon matches.
Verbatim CDFW map-class labels with regional record counts; all mapped classes, not just coastal classes.
Distinct publisher habitat strings from full upstream GBIF records, separated by |. Verbatim context, not curated species ecology.
Regional records whose publisher habitat text explicitly mentions dune, backdune or foredune; a text-screen flag, not validated specialization.
Regional records whose publisher habitat text mentions beach, wrack, seaweed or kelp; a text-screen flag, not validated specialization.
Aggregate regional map-category counts, with counts for which reported coordinate-uncertainty radius lies within individual matched polygon. Not a habitat preference estimate.
Reminder distinguishing occurrence-location evidence from habitat specialization; blank if no selected regional map-category matches.
Local species-matched Ecdysis records for this species anywhere on the preserve. Not added to regional occurrence_count; source overlap is possible.
Counts by explicit Perko's Beach, field-described backdune, other beach locality, or unspecified context. Preserve-wide evidence, not tied to candidate ecoregion.
Distinct original Ecdysis habitat strings, separated by |. Locality-derived backdune context may also appear in ecdysis_site_contexts when habitat is blank.
CDFW polygon classes and local Ecdysis record counts, separate from regional mapped_vegetation_classes. Map predates 2022 restoration.
Sourced species-level habitat account; see review status for genus-level life-history qualifications.
Source URLs for reviewed habitat and life-history accounts; semicolon-delimited if multiple.
not reviewed or description of the level of reviewed support. Genus-level feeding context is explicitly labeled.
URLs for the map sources when regional points match either map; detailed downloads and hashes are in raw archive_manifest.json.
